text:
anna_finance: Heads-up — customer ClearPoint Labs invoice INV-3421 failed to charge the primary card. Last 3 attempts returned declines. Trying retries now but want guidance: do we spin up a manual wire option or send a paylink first? @jess_sales any context on urgency?

billing-bot: Charge failed: id=ch_3NxxYyZ code=card_declined decline_code=insufficient_funds attempts=3 last_attempt=2026-03-20T14:02:22Z

michael_ops: If this blocks access, wire is fine but involves manual steps (verify beneficiary + accounting). Do we have verified wire/ACH for this customer in our system?

anna_finance: We only have a card on file. They submitted ACH info last month but never finished micro-deposits — status = unverified. Saved details (masked): routing=XXXXX acct=****1234.

jess_sales: @anna_finance customer is annual and paused access would be bad. Sales okayed waiving the $25 manual-wire processing fee if we need to go that route — they want it resolved today.

lina_support: Confirmed: support ticket #9876 shows they attempted microdeposits yesterday; agent note says customer will send wire details if card keeps failing.

michael_ops: Proposed flow: 1) Send a one-click paylink (fastest). 2) If they prefer bank transfer, accept wire and apply immediately. Anna, can you create a paylink with 7-day expiry and include optional wire instructions in the message? If paylink fails, escalate to manual wire.

anna_finance: Will create paylink now and pause automatic retry attempts. Drafting message to customer (below) — posting here for approval and for @finance-approvals to consider fee waiver. @jess_sales tagging you for visibility.

billing-bot: Suggested customer message and sample wire stub:
```
Hi ClearPoint team — your invoice INV-3421 is overdue. You can pay instantly here: https://pay.rlwd.io/pay/INV-3421 (expires in 7 days). If you prefer bank transfer, please send payment to:

Bank: Redwood Settlement / Acme Bank
Routing (ABA): 021000xxx
Account: 123456xxx
Reference: INV-3421 / ClearPoint Labs

Please reply with the payment method you choose and attach wire confirmation if you send a transfer so we can apply it right away.
```

anna_finance: Sending paylink now and opening a finance escalation for manual application if they wire. Holding further automated retries. Will update when customer responds. :wave:
